passage_ja: A software company introduced a policy that allows employees to work from home up to three days a week. Before the change, all staff were required to be in the office every weekday. One year later, the company surveyed its 400 employees. About 70 percent said they were more satisfied with their jobs than before. The number of employees who left the company fell from 48 in the previous year to 30. However, some managers reported that it had become harder to train new staff, because junior employees had fewer chances to learn by watching experienced colleagues. The company plans to keep the policy but will ask new hires to come to the office four days a week during their first six months.
question_ja:
Read the passage and decide whether the statement below is A, B or C.
Employees may now work from home every day of the week.
choices: The statement is clearly true, or follows logically, given the information in the passage.
The statement is clearly untrue, or the opposite follows logically, given the information in the passage.
You cannot say whether the statement is true or untrue without further information.
answer: The statement is clearly untrue, or the opposite follows logically, given the information in the passage.
explanation_short_ja: 正解は B。"up to three days a week"(週に最大三日)とある。毎日ではない。
explanation_detail_ja: 設問文: Employees may now work from home every day of the week.
根拠: "up to three days a week"(週に最大三日)とある。毎日ではない。
判定: 本文の記述と食い違う → B
explanation_ko:
지문 요지: 한 소프트웨어 회사가 주 3일까지 재택근무를 허용했다. 1년 뒤 직원 400명 중 약 70%가 전보다 만족한다고 답했고, 퇴사자는 48명에서 30명으로 줄었다. 다만 일부 관리자는 신입 교육이 어려워졌다고 했다. 회사는 제도를 유지하되, 신입은 첫 6개월간 주 4일 출근하게 할 계획이다.
설문: 직원들은 이제 매일 재택근무를 할 수 있다.
정답 B (분명히 틀림): "up to three days a week"(주 3일까지)이므로 매일은 아닙니다.
tip: 数字・方向(増えた/減った)・範囲(すべて/一部)が本文と食い違えば B。

passage_ja: A coffee shop chain began charging customers an extra 20 cents for each disposable cup in order to reduce waste. Customers who bring their own cup pay the regular price. In the first three months, the share of drinks sold in reusable cups rose from 5 percent to 18 percent. Total sales did not change significantly during the period. The chain said the money collected from the cup charge would be donated to local environmental groups. Some customers complained that the charge was unfair to people who buy coffee on the way to work without planning ahead. The chain is now testing a system in two stores where customers can borrow a cup and return it at any branch.
question_ja:

Customers who bring their own cup receive a discount on the regular price.
choices: The statement is clearly true, or follows logically, given the information in the passage.

You cannot say whether the statement is true or untrue without further information.
answer: The statement is clearly untrue, or the opposite follows logically, given the information in the passage.
explanation_short_ja: 正解は B。"Customers who bring their own cup pay the regular price." とある。割引ではなく通常価格を払う。
explanation_detail_ja: 設問文: Customers who bring their own cup receive a discount on the regular price.
根拠: "Customers who bring their own cup pay the regular price." とある。割引ではなく通常価格を払う。
判定: 本文の記述と食い違う → B
explanation_ko:
지문 요지: 한 커피 체인이 쓰레기를 줄이려고 일회용 컵에 20센트를 더 받기 시작했다. 자기 컵을 가져오면 정가를 낸다. 3개월 만에 재사용 컵 비율이 5%에서 18%로 올랐고, 전체 매출은 큰 변화가 없었다. 컵 요금은 지역 환경 단체에 기부한다. 현재 두 매장에서 컵 대여 제도를 시험 중이다.
설문: 자기 컵을 가져오는 손님은 정가에서 할인을 받는다.
정답 B (분명히 틀림): 자기 컵을 가져오면 "정가를 낸다"고 했습니다. 할인이 아닙니다.
tip: 数字・方向(増えた/減った)・範囲(すべて/一部)が本文と食い違えば B。

passage_ja: An online retailer introduced a chatbot to answer common customer questions, such as delivery dates and return rules. passage_ja: A language-learning app studied how its users practise. It found that users who studied for ten minutes every day remembered more words after three months than users who studied for seventy minutes once a week, even though the total study time was the same. The app's researchers believe that short, frequent sessions give the brain more chances to recall information before it is forgotten. The study also found that users who set a reminder on their phone were twice as likely to keep studying for more than a month. However, the study only looked at vocabulary. The researchers said they did not know whether the same pattern would be found for speaking or writing skills.
question_ja:
Read the passage and decide whether the statement below is A, B or C.
The two groups compared in the study spent the same total amount of time studying.
choices: The statement is clearly true, or follows logically, given the information in the passage.
The statement is clearly untrue, or the opposite follows logically, given the information in the passage.
You cannot say whether the statement is true or untrue without further information.
answer: The statement is clearly true, or follows logically, given the information in the passage.
explanation_short_ja: 正解は A。"even though the total study time was the same" とある(毎日10分×7日=70分、週1回70分)。
explanation_detail_ja: 設問文: The two groups compared in the study spent the same total amount of time studying.
根拠: "even though the total study time was the same" とある(毎日10分×7日=70分、週1回70分)。
判定: 本文に書かれている、または本文から必ず導ける → A
explanation_ko:
지문 요지: 한 언어 학습 앱이 이용자의 학습 방식을 조사했다. 매일 10분 공부한 사람이 주 1회 70분 공부한 사람보다 3개월 뒤 단어를 더 많이 기억했다(총 학습 시간은 같음). 알림을 설정한 사람은 한 달 넘게 계속할 가능성이 2배였다. 다만 조사 대상은 어휘뿐이고, 말하기·쓰기에도 같은지는 모른다고 했다.
설문: 조사에서 비교한 두 그룹은 총 학습 시간이 같았다.
정답 A (분명히 맞음): "총 학습 시간은 같았다"고 했습니다(매일 10분 × 7일 = 70분).
tip: 本文の内容を別の言い方にしただけなら A。数字は「約六割 → 半数以上」のように言い換えられる。
